# clean data

```{r}
# 1. Load the raw data
my_data_raw = read.csv("depression_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

# 2. Create 'my_data' by sampling from the raw data first
set.seed(123) # Good practice for reproducibility when sampling
my_data <- my_data_raw[sample(1:nrow(my_data_raw), 0.1 * nrow(my_data_raw)), ]

# 3. Now that 'my_data' exists, you can remove the Name column
# (You don't need the 'removes' vector if you just do this)
my_data$Name <- NULL

# 4. Handle character to factor conversion 
# (Note: stringsAsFactors = TRUE in read.csv usually handles this, 
# but this is a good safety net for any newly created columns)
char_cols <- sapply(my_data, is.character)
my_data[char_cols] <- lapply(my_data[char_cols], as.factor)

# 5. Check the results
str(my_data)
summary(my_data)

# Save the manageable portion for your other modular files
saveRDS(my_data, "cleaned_depression.rds")
```

# export

```{r}
saveRDS(my_data, file = "cleaned_depression.rds")

nrow(my_data)
```
